documentTitle: Clinical Diagnostic Performance Analysis of SparseCross-ViT
institution: Center for Advanced Medical Machine Learning
abstract: We present SparseCross-ViT, an asymmetric cross-attention vision transformer that reduces self-attention memory overhead by 64% while maintaining 98.4% top-1 diagnostic accuracy across 120,000 multi-label chest radiograph scans.
conclusions: Dynamic token pruning decouples contextual pooling from local spatial extraction without diagnostic quality loss.
Enables real-time point-of-care clinical inference on standard hospital edge workstations.
